Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: transparent cutout illustration for a Chinese reinforcement learning lesson, shown about 260 by 165 pixels.
Primary request: create a polished miniature expanded logistics warehouse, one cohesive isometric cutaway diorama. A blue-and-white wheeled delivery robot with a dark navy face screen, cyan eyes and small yellow antenna moves between three short shelving rows with warm cardboard parcels. Show a small blue automatic doorway and a compact green charging dock as meaningful state factors. White and pale blue floor, sky blue shelf frames, restrained green accents, soft warm parcel colors. Modern friendly 3D educational render, smooth white ceramic/plastic materials and gentle realistic shading. High camera angle, compact horizontal composition, entire warehouse island visible, simple readable silhouettes at small size, objects large enough to recognize.
Constraints: no words, letters, numbers, labels, diagram arrows, UI, charts, logos or watermark. Not a measured 100x100 blueprint; a conceptual warehouse illustration. No large background, no surrounding room, no hard rectangular image border. Isolated on genuine transparent background with a subtle contact shadow. All edges intact, generous 5% safe margin.

Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: transparent cutout illustration for a Chinese Q-learning lesson, shown about 180 by 110 pixels.
Primary request: a simple polished 3D conceptual illustration of a Q table becoming enormous: four pale-blue rectangular spreadsheet-like grid sheets stacked and fanning upward in perspective, each sheet has a simple regular matrix of blank square cells, combined with a small blue memory-storage block at their base and one small coral-red warning triangle. One cohesive compact object, readable at thumbnail size. Match a friendly modern blue-and-white educational warehouse robot course: smooth rounded plastic edges, soft cyan and navy details, minimal green accent, gentle studio lighting, no excessive glow. Entire object visible, three-quarter isometric perspective, horizontal composition.
Constraints: all grid cells must be blank; no invented data, text, letters, digits, equations, symbols or logos. No scenery or background panel. Transparent background with a subtle contact shadow, intact edges and 5% safe margin. This is an explanatory physical metaphor, not a real data table.
